MAC RELEASE

Mac 1.5.15 · build 31

A compact view of today, with the features and appearance you choose.

Latest public release2026-10-19
HighlightsImprovementsSupport and limitsDownloads

Highlights

See your arrival and scheduled departure in one card, with a short preview of up to three events for today. Manage detailed options in the separate Settings window.

Enter arrival as four digits or use the +/− buttons above and below each digit. For example, type 0900 for 09:00, then click elsewhere or close the panel to save. Digits and buttons stay in place while editing.

Choose regular work, morning half-day leave, afternoon half-day leave, Lulu Day, or annual/public leave without connecting a calendar. Choosing a mode alone does not create an arrival record.

Improvements

  • Lulu Day reduces a regular workday by 120 minutes. Explicitly choosing regular work removes the reduction; half-days do not receive it twice.
  • Annual/public leave preserves the original arrival time and pauses automatic recording and the countdown.
  • Choose Calendar, DaouOffice, and automatic leave recognition separately in plugin management, with developer credits and individual settings.
  • Choose from five calm themes and five icons based on the original logo, adjust colors, or import a PNG/JPEG icon.
  • Existing calendar connections and half-day recognition migrate while explicitly disabled connections and inactive plugin settings are preserved. Paste, focus changes, and date/time-zone boundaries receive additional handling.

Support and limits

macOS 13 or later; Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel. These screen, plugin, and appearance changes are Mac-only. The latest public Windows release remains 1.5.13.

Invalid formats, future times, date changes, and arrival times incompatible with the selected work mode are not saved. Existing record locations and the app identifier are preserved.

The DaouOffice plugin is developed by 손정열. It reads events and leave from the server without creating, editing, or deleting them remotely. Two-way synchronization between macOS calendars is a separate feature.

Uses a fixed self-signed certificate and Sparkle update signatures. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not applied. Other Macs, physical Intel hardware, actual unlock/reboot login, and company-account server round trips remain separate validation scopes.

Downloads

Open the DMG and move HappyLulu to Applications, or extract the ZIP and move the app. Quit the existing app before replacing it.
